item.description:
What's New

  • You can now archive notes instead of deleting them
  • We've added tagging! Each note is limited to 3, one-word tags for simplicity's sake. We may expand this once you all tell us how you're using tags or when auto-tagging goes live later.
  • We've upgraded search to now include a filter system for tags as well as identifiers such as Published or Archived notes.
  • The created date for notes will now display in the format you have on your device at an OS level./li>
  • We now show the transcript instead of the note preview in the list to the left.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an issue where sharing a note would change the actively selected note which could cause Shortcuts to run on the wrong note content.

What's New

  • Brand new UI for writing and viewing notes.
  • Support for more file formats when uploading and attaching files
  • Moved the formatting buttons into a drop down menu
  • Added undo and redo buttons to the writing tab
  • Hid the welcome note from the notes list on the left

Plans

  • Basic Plan: Free plan now available.
  • Plus Plan: New Plus plan introduced with additional features.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an issue where losing network could make your note disappear

What's New

  • Obsidian Integration: You can now sync your clefts to a local folder in .md format. Note: Please install the Front Matter Title community plugin for the best experience with Cleft.
  • Image and File Uploads: You can now insert images, photos, documents, and more. These files are uploaded securely to your account which allows them to show up on published links
  • Language Selection: Improved language selection that ties to the input language you pick. The AI will also respond in the spoken language by default if it's able to.
  • 30-Minute Notes: Record notes up to 30 minutes on the Plus plan.

Plans

  • Basic Plan: Free plan now available.
  • Plus Plan: New Plus plan introduced with additional features.

Bug Fixes

  • Bluetooth Issues: Fixed tinny sound issues with certain Bluetooth earphones.
  • Date Issues in Notes: Resolved date-related issues in notes.
  • Apple Silicon Transcription: Increased speed and accuracy of transcription on Apple Silicon devices.
